resources.string: Test pop-up in 15 seconds. Start the screensaver or open another app to try it.
Sign in to Eufy in the app to see live video

Test pop-up

To test with real video, copy a .h264 clip to
Android/data/io.github.adamstottdev.eufytv/files/test.h264
Allowed: the pop-up shows on top of everything
Not allowed yet, so the pop-up opens full screen instead. From a computer run:\nadb shell appops set %1$s SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
Not excluded. If events arrive late after the TV sleeps, run:\nadb shell dumpsys deviceidle whitelist +%1$s
QR code for signing in on your phone
Easiest: scan this with your phone (on the same Wi-Fi) and enter your details there. You can paste from your password manager.\n\nOr type them on the right.
Got your details from your phone. Signing in…

Use the email and password you sign in to the Eufy Security app with.

Tip: a second Eufy account works best. Create one with another email, then in the Eufy app on your phone share your doorbell and cameras with it. Signing in here with your main account can sometimes sign your phone out.

If you normally sign in to Eufy with Google or Apple, your account has no password: use a second account as above.

To type on the TV, the Google TV app on your phone has a keyboard that types straight into the TV.

Your password stays on this TV, encrypted with its secure key storage, and is only sent to Eufy.
Password (leave empty to keep the saved one)
Country code, e.g. GB or US
Enter the two-letter code of the country your Eufy account is in, such as GB.
Eufy emailed a verification code to %1$s. Type it in to finish signing in.
Eufy wants to check you are a person. Type the characters in the picture.
Can\'t reach Eufy right now (%1$s). Trying again by itself.
Not signed in. Select to sign in.
%1$s · needs you to sign in again
Sign in to see your cameras
Eufy TV Doorbell: Eufy signed you out (%1$s). Open Eufy TV Doorbell to sign in again. Doorbell pop-ups are off until then.
Eufy TV Doorbell: Eufy needs you to sign in again. Open Eufy TV Doorbell to finish. Doorbell pop-ups are off until then.
Eufy TV Doorbell can\'t connect to Eufy (%1$s). Doorbell pop-ups won\'t show until it reconnects. Still trying.
Eufy TV Doorbell isn\'t receiving doorbell events from Eufy. Pop-ups may not show. Still trying.
Eufy TV Doorbell isn\'t allowed to show over other apps, so pop-ups open full screen. Open the app for how to fix it.
Eufy TV Doorbell is connected again
